note: MDC campground at the south end of the 44-acre lake, off County Road 524: a gravel spine with eight angled gravel spurs in timber, tables and a privy, ending in a turnaround. A second short lane just east has three more spurs and a turnaround beside a cove, with an open lawn between the lane and the water; those are the spurs with a lake view. A third designated spot is the gravel canoe-launch lot on the west arm off County Road 547 (privy, no pads). Picnic shelter and boat ramp near the south camp. No water. Gravel county roads in. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: a built MDC campground ('improved camping') with gravel spurs and privies - stays. Phone matches. Free/FCFS/14 nights/no hookups confirmed. PIN: on the minor west canoe-launch lot; move 515 m to the main south camp. WATERFRONT LEAD: lakefront not earned - recommend lakeview.
flags: THREE DESIGNATED SPOTS, ONE MAIN CAMP: the page says 'Area facilities/features include: boat ramp, improved camping, picnic areas and pavilion' and lists 'Individual Campsites'. The 10/08 map legend has 'Primitive Camping Area' and uses the symbol three times: twice at the south end off C.R. 524 (on the two gravel lanes east of the Picnic Shelter / Boat Ramp lot, with a Privy) and once at the west lot off C.R. 547 (with Canoe Launch and Privy). GIS layer 27 has three 'Primitive Camping Area' points to match: 39.23429,-91.53551 and 39.23476,-91.53494 (south) and 39.23889,-91.53871 (west). Imagery (leaf-off, 0.13-0.16 m/px): (1) the main camp is a gravel spine about 110 m long with eight angled gravel spurs (four each side, herringbone), tables, and a privy on a concrete pad at the end turnaround, all in timber; (2) 60 m east, a second gravel lane about 90 m long ends in a turnaround 12-15 m from a lake cove and has three gravel spurs on its WEST side; (3) the west spot is a single gravel lot about 35 x 20 m at the canoe launch with a privy and mown grass around it, no pads. No brochure PDF, so no published site count or campsite season; the eleven spurs are an imagery count and not written.

PIN MOVE: stored 39.23889,-91.53871 is the west canoe-launch lot, the minor spot. The main camp's spine is at 39.23487,-91.53574 (about 515 m south-east). Move the pin there. All three spots share one small lake and are under 600 m apart, so no split.

WATERFRONT LEAD (stored lakefront; recommend LAKEVIEW): counted from the pads. Main camp, 8 spurs: in closed timber, the nearest spur ends about 33 m from the cove but across the east lane and through trees - no water seen. East lane, 3 spurs: they sit on the west side of the lane, 25-35 m from the shore, with the campground's own lane and then an open mown lawn 15-25 m wide between them and the water, no trees on the lawn - a clear lake view, but the lane lies between the pads and the water, which is *view under the 2026-11-01 rulings. West lot (the stored pin): a canoe-launch parking lot whose gravel is about 35 m from the cove across mown grass - a ramp lot's apron, lakeview at best. The only ground actually on the water is the lawn east of the east lane's turnaround (where the GIS point 39.23476,-91.53494 falls, about 8 m from the bank), which is tent ground, not a pad. So no pad is on an open apron at the shore with nothing between; three of eleven spurs plus the west lot have an open view. Lakefront is not earned; it goes down to lakeview. The stored waterfront_evidence was read at the west-lot pin.
ACCESS: gravel C.R. 524 (south camp) and C.R. 547 (west lot) from Route K or Route W; no ford, no posted limit, no 4WD wording. The spurs look 12-18 m long; site length is not published.
PHONE: stored 573-815-7900 matches the page's 'For more information call (573) 815-7900'.
Nothing else in the database within 3 km.
